messages:
morgan: Quick sync — we discovered duplicated cost attribution downstream when we bridge envelopes into analytics and also stream derived events to billing. wondering if we should canonicalize at the bridge or at the analytics consumer.

alex: saw that too. root cause looked like two paths ingesting the same tenant/billing_key: once on the raw envelope fanout, once after enrichment.

casey: my vote is canonicalize at the bridge layer. emit a single canonical record (bridge_id + billing_key) and then have consumers subscribe to that topic. avoids consumers needing dedupe logic.

jen: +1 to central canonicalization, but we need to handle late enrichment: sometimes billing_key is populated after the bridge. do we emit a tombstone/update?

tara: for late enrich, we used a small reconciliation stream in another project: emit placeholder events with status=partial, then emit an update when billing_key lands. consumers do an upsert keyed by envelope_id. keeps cost stable.

morgan: can you paste the minimal config you used? trying to keep infra changes small.

jen: snippet from that project: 
```
kafka:
  topic: analytics-canonical
  key: envelope_id
  value_schema: envelope.canonical.v1
producer:
  emit_partial: true
  partial_ttl_seconds: 300
```

alex: also consider adding a short dedupe window on the billing pipeline (idempotency token + last_seen_ts). cheap safety net if a consumer misses update ordering.

casey: note tradeoff: dedupe window increases state and can mask bugs. but central canonicalization reduces consumer complexity.

tara: for SLA reasons, analytics consumers prefer eventually-correct upsert semantics (small window). that fits our RL for queries.

morgan: thoughts on migration strategy? we have existing consumers directly reading envelope-fanout topic.

casey: phased rollout: 1) bridge emits canonical in parallel, 2) add consumer opt-in to canonical topic, 3) flip producer to only canonical once adoption >= 90%.

jen: add a telemetry flag so we can count how many consumers moved. expose metric: analytics.canonical_subscribers

alex: also add a lightweight schema evolution plan: canonical record includes billing_key|null, envelope_id, event_ts, partial_flag. consumers must tolerate nulls.

morgan: agree. i'll draft a short RFC for the migration steps and a small ops runbook (rollback if billing counts drop unexpectedly).

deploy-bot: consumer/analytics-canonical updated to v2.1 at 1719487720 :rocket:

tara: ok — action items: casey to prototype bridge partial/update flow, jen to add telemetry flag to consumer, alex to draft dedupe-window opt-in. i'll own rollout coordination.

morgan: thanks — lets sync Friday 10am. if anyone hits a blocker, ping here and include quick repro (envelope_id + timestamps). :thumbsup:
